releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.64 makes Home Quick Actions act immediately while preserving the current Home design. Scan now starts the existing scan flow directly, Search opens Files on the Search tab, and New Note opens the existing note editor directly. The Home greeting, Celsius/Fahrenheit temperature and date are slightly larger for readability. Files categories/search behavior, Notes data, Library, Settings, saved files, indexing, sharing and all other current functions are unchanged.
